interface.description: IP address for the web server to listen on (from -i/--interface)

port.description: Port for the web server to listen on (from -p/--port)

base_path.description: Base path that the web UI is running on (from -b/--base); empty for root path

ssl.description: Enable SSL for the web server (from --ssl); false means disabled unless forced

log_level.description: Log level: none, info, warning, error, debug (from -L/--loglevel)

logfile.description: Path to logfile; empty means stdout/stderr (from -l/--logfile)

log_rotate.description: Enable log rotation with default max size (from --logrotate); max size is 2M with 5 rotations

max_log_size.description: Maximum logfile size for rotation (from --logrotate=max-size); accepts sizes like 2M, 10M, etc.

pidfile.description: Path to pidfile for process control (from -P/--pidfile)

user.description: User to drop to on startup (requires root; from -U/--user)

group.description: Group to drop to on startup (requires root; from -g/--group)
